messages:
maya: Quick ask — need a concise latency vs cost narrative for the launch card next week. Two visual assets (static social + interactive demo) + 3 short hooks. Who can help?

devon: I'm in. Can we make one chart that surfaces tail latency for chat and another that shows $/1k tokens across model variants? Want something product + platform folks can use. :thinking_face: 

liam: I can mock both. Plan: 1) scatter (x=latency ms, y=$/1k tokens) with iso-cost curves to show tradeoffs; 2) CDF of response times to highlight median→p95→p99. Add inset for prefix-cache savings.

sam: For headlines — a few tones: 1) "Choose latency or unit-cost — optimize both with Redwood" 2) "How we trade ms for dollars: real workloads" 3) "Faster answers, smarter economics" Keep PLG-forward with enterprise detail on landing.

maya: Social headline = punchy. Landing page gets explainer + CTA.

devon: Inbound routing: three flows — SMB (self-serve demo), Platform (dedicated AE), Enterprise (private/KMS). UTM tags: utm_medium=bench, utm_segment=sm|platform|enterprise. Internal tags: bench_smb|bench_platform|bench_private. HubSpot mapping established.

eva: Draft landing blurb: "See how production teams balance latency and unit economics with real workloads. Live demo of caching, batching, and routing strategies that cut cost without slowing users." CTA: "Estimate your token cost" -> bench_demo.

liam: Chart config for design: ```json {"chart":"scatter","x":"median_latency_ms","x_detail":["p95","p99"],"y":"cost_per_1k_tokens","color_by":"model_family","iso_cost_lines":true,"annotations":["prefix_cache_savings","quantized_variants"]} ``` Will annotate example points: open-xxq, redwood-opt-xxq, private-dedicated.

sam: Short social copy options:
- "Latency vs $/1k tokens: which way does your workload lean? See real numbers -> [link]"
- "Cut token costs, keep the speed. How teams choose tradeoffs. Demo: [link]"
- "Predictable latency, predictable spend — Redwood's playbook. RSVP: [link]"
Pick for linkedin/twitter/email.

maya: Need webinar slide lines too.

eva: Webinar slide: Title: "Serving LLMs: Balancing Latency & Unit Economics" Subhead: "Live demo: caching, batching, and routing strategies that reduce token spend while preserving tail latency"

devon: Ops: liam deliverables — PNG social (1200x628), interactive Vega preview for demo, and small GIF showing cache on/off latency shift. Deadline Friday EOD. I'll set HubSpot flows + tracking (click->segment, interact->higher lead score). Goal CTR to demo >= 8% initially.

liam: Timeline OK. I'll upload PNG + spec by Friday and include in-chart callouts: "Quantized models cut $/1k by X%".

maya: In-product banner copy (very short): "See predicted token cost for your prompt" and "Estimate latency for 3 common workflows" — both route to bench_demo.

sam: I'll A/B test headline 1 vs 3 on landing once assets live.

eva: I'll publish landing + webinar blurb by Thursday for review.

maya: Nice — narrative: make tradeoffs explicit, provide an actionable next step (estimate/demo), and route inbound by segment. Tag #assets when PNG + interactive are uploaded. Deadline Friday. :rocket:
